 How to play GTA 6 early before its official release in your country 
 How to play GTA 6 early before its official release in your country
 By 
 Mudassir Kamran 
 Modified Nov 02, 2026 15:04 IST 
 How to play GTA 6 early before its official release in your country (Image via Rockstar Games) 
 With GTA 6 scheduled to launch on November 19, 2026, players are looking for ways to enter Vice City before the game officially becomes available in their country. The regional release schedule could give some players a head start over others, making the launch timing particularly interesting for console owners. 
 Ad 
 However, getting access earlier may depend on your platform and regional store settings. Here is what you need to know before trying to play GTA 6 early.
 How to play GTA 6 early on Xbox and PS5 before its regional release
 Grand Theft Auto 6 is scheduled to launch on November 19, 2026, but players in some countries could access it earlier due to differences in regional release times. New Zealand is expected to be among the first regions to unlock the game.

 Xbox Series X|S owners may be able to use a location change to access it early. PS5 users have a different workaround that requires a separate PlayStation Network account.
 How to play GTA 6 early on PS5 
 PS5 users cannot simply change their console region to New Zealand. Instead, they may need a separate PSN account registered in that country. Here are the steps:
 Create a new PlayStation Network account and select New Zealand as the country.
 Obtain a New Zealand PSN gift card to fund the account.
 Purchase GTA 6 through the New Zealand PlayStation Store .
 Enable Console Sharing and Offline Play in the PS5 settings.
 Switch back to your primary account and check whether the game launches.
 Ad 
 How to play GTA 6 early on Xbox Series X|S 
 Xbox players can try changing their console location to New Zealand. Follow these steps:
 Open Settings on your Xbox console.
 Select System, then open Language & location.
 Change the Location setting to New Zealand .
 Restart your console to apply the changes.
 Once the game unlocks in that region, check whether the game is available to launch.
 This method may not work if Rockstar Games or Microsoft applies regional restrictions. Microsoft also limits how frequently users can change their console region.
 Ad 
 Players who prefer to avoid these complications can pre-load Grand Theft Auto 6 from November 12, 2026, according to Rockstar's support page. This allows the game to download before launch, although it will remain locked until the applicable release time.
